title: Consolidated coverage for the BEE_CHECK_ONLY check filter
action: Author scripts/tests/test_check_filter.mjs — one consolidated suite over the NET behavior cfl-1 shipped in scripts/lib/test-fixture.mjs, not its internals. Because CHECK_ONLY is computed once at module load, every behavioral check must spawn a child node process running a synthetic suite that imports the real fixture, with BEE_CHECK_ONLY set in that child's env. Cover: (happy) unfiltered run is byte-identical to pre-cfl-1 — summary matches /^\d+ passed, \d+ failed$/ exactly, no SKIP lines, no skip counter, no BEE_CHECK_ONLY text, exit 0; (happy) case-insensitive substring filter runs only matching checks, prints SKIP for the rest, and the summary names both the skip count and the pattern; (edge) /regex/ form is honoured including flags; (edge) skipped checks are never folded into the passed count; (error) a filter matching zero checks exits non-zero with the typed refusal and never prints a 0-passed green summary; (error) an invalid /regex/ exits non-zero with the typed message rather than throwing a raw SyntaxError at import; (error) a filtered run whose MATCHING check fails still exits 1 — the filter never masks a real failure. Also unit-test the exported checkOnlyPredicate directly (in-process): null for empty/unset, substring predicate case-insensitivity, regex predicate. Use the repo's own shared fixture for the new suite itself.

truths: The suite is discovered by scripts/run_verify.mjs without any hand-registration.
Unfiltered byte-identity is asserted on the actual summary line, not merely on the exit code.
The zero-match refusal is proven to exit non-zero AND to not print a passed/failed green summary.
A failing matched check under a filter still exits 1.
prohibitions: Do NOT change scripts/lib/test-fixture.mjs — this cell authors coverage only.
Do NOT assert on internal counters directly; assert on observable child-process output and exit codes.
Do NOT convert the 22 suites with a local check().
